comment.value: Daughter board for Elecrow CrowPanel Advance HMI 4.3 inch
ES8311 codec + TPA6111A2 HP amp + fail-safe relays + LEMO/aviation connectors
Connects to Elecrow main board via 3 JST cables
See docs/BLOCK_SPECS.md for component values and pinouts
